name: Saff
summary: Three prayer rugs form one peaceful row, with a warm central rug and open prayer niches.
why: Aligned rugs express congregation without depicting worshippers. Short fringe and pointed niches identify the textiles, while the broad rhythm suggests belonging and a shared direction of prayer.
risk: At very small sizes the fringe softens and the rugs can resemble three framed doorways. The prayer association is clearest at normal launcher size.
sub2: A welcoming place in the row
reasonToChoose: Prayer and community should lead the identity, without human figures.
